limits: Remaining transient probe attribution stays open; no claim that all historical episodes have this cause.
Background worker SQL overlapping a timeout does not prove event-loop blocking.
Bounded trace/capture budgets and drop counters limit attribution.
One-hour local emulated acceptance is not a guarantee of indefinite no-leak or production uptime.
Original Demo config/volume/account untouched; no new-image connected Demo session or Cloud Run deployment.

residual_analysis.scope: All retained R1 healthy-envelope episodes, one-second pre-marker context and bounded top-five records. R2 is uninstrumented and has no equivalent stack evidence.

limits: Overlaps and sampled stacks do not establish a unique cause.
Main-thread ownership/recorder work remains synchronous. Worker SQL overlaps must not be treated as main-thread blocking.
Client SQL span includes transport/runtime/scheduling work, not just PostgreSQL server execution.
Supervisor recovery intervals include scheduling until the next probe and are not quote downtime.
No causal stack attribution is available for the six ordinary-entrypoint R2 episodes.
